description: ADSR envelope generator with a gate output for each stage, a combined trigger output and a variable contour

params.text: Sets the attack time, about 3ms at the bottom to about 10 seconds at the top
Sets the decay time, about 3ms at the bottom to about 12 seconds at the top
Sets the level the envelope rests at after the decay, 0-10V; at the bottom the envelope becomes an AD and at the top an ASR
Sets the release time, about 3ms at the bottom to about 12 seconds at the top
Fires an envelope by hand, and lights in step with the contour being generated
GATE mode runs every stage while the gate is high and releases on its falling edge; TRIG mode completes the attack and then goes straight to the release
Morphs the contour from linear anticlockwise to a logarithmic attack with exponential decay and release clockwise

inputs.text: Shifts that stage's time, summed with its fader; negative voltage brings the shortest time down to about 0.4ms
Shifts the sustain level, 0-10V summed with the fader
A gate or trigger above 3V starts the envelope

outputs.text: A 10V trigger at the start of every envelope stage
A 10V gate held for the length of that stage

inputs.4: high above 3V · stepped · one channel only
